description: PIAM/BNM consumer credit telemarketing disclosures — v0 for Malaysian credit card outbound. Built from public BNM consumer protection guidelines and PIAM conduct materials. v1 will be co-developed with client compliance team.
regulator_refs: BNM Policy Document on Fair Treatment of Financial Consumers (2019)
BNM Guidelines on Credit Card (2011, updated)
PIAM Code of Ethics & Conduct (public summary)

rules.title: AI identity proactively disclosed
rules.requirement: Within the first two agent turns, the agent must proactively state it is an AI assistant / automated system. This is our stance on transparency (developmentplan.md §2 C) and reduces post-call complaints + pre-empts deceptive-AI regulation.
rules.copilot_card: Say: 'I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of…' in your next turn.

rules.title: Agent and company identity disclosure
rules.requirement: Within the first 30 seconds of speech, the agent must state their name and the company they are calling on behalf of.

detection.prompt: Did the agent clearly state their name AND the company/institution they represent within their first two turns? Return JSON {"fired": true/false, "evidence": "verbatim quote or null"}

rules.title: Call recording consent
rules.requirement: Before discussing any product details, the agent must disclose that the call is being recorded and obtain explicit consent (or acknowledgment) from the consumer.

detection.prompt: Did the agent explicitly tell the consumer the call is being recorded AND wait for a response before discussing product details? Return JSON {"fired": true/false, "evidence": "verbatim quote or null"}

rules.title: Effective interest rate disclosure
rules.requirement: For credit products, the agent must disclose the effective interest rate (not just promotional rate) when discussing financial terms.
rules.demo_note: THIS IS THE ORCHESTRATED MISS. Human closer deliberately omits the effective-rate disclosure when discussing the 3.5% promotional rate. Copilot fires this flag in red.

rules.title: No pressure / urgency tactics
rules.requirement: The agent must not use artificial urgency (e.g. 'today only', 'limited offer', 'last chance') to push a sale decision.

rules.title: Opt-out acknowledged within 10 seconds
rules.requirement: If the consumer states they are not interested or asks to be removed from the call list, the agent must acknowledge and end the pitch within 10 seconds.

detection.prompt: Did the consumer explicitly decline or ask to be removed, and did the agent respect it without continuing to pitch? Return JSON {"consumer_opted_out": true/false, "agent_respected": true/false, "evidence": "verbatim quote or null"}

rules.title: No false affiliation or government claims
rules.requirement: The agent must not claim to be calling from or on behalf of a government agency, regulator, or an institution they do not represent.

rules.title: Third-party disclosure refusal
rules.requirement: If someone other than the account holder answers, the agent must not disclose the reason for the call or any account details.

detection.prompt: If a third party (not the target customer) answered, did the agent refuse to disclose the reason for the call? Return JSON {"third_party_answered": true/false, "agent_leaked": true/false, "evidence": "verbatim quote or null"}

rules.title: AI agent must not close sale
rules.requirement: The AI First-Touch agent must only qualify interest and transfer to human. It must not collect signature, confirm application, or state binding terms.

detection.prompt: Did the AI agent stay within scope (qualify + transfer), or did it attempt to close, bind terms, or collect application-level confirmation? Return JSON {"exceeded_scope": true/false, "evidence": "verbatim quote or null"}
